paper_title: Repository to store code for effects of SPT6:SPN1 interaction mutants on nucleosome positioning at the TTS
readme:
# SPN1 nucleosomes and transcription termination

Analysis code for investigating how perturbation of the **Spt6–Spn1 interaction affects nucleosome organization and transcription in *Saccharomyces cerevisiae***.

This repository contains the scripts used for processing MNase-seq data, defining gene and nucleosome annotations, quantifying nucleosome organization around transcription start and termination sites, and integrating nucleosome organization with transcription datasets.

The analysis is organized according to the figures of the associated manuscript.

## Overview

Spt6 and Spn1 are conserved transcription-associated factors involved in maintaining chromatin organization during transcription. This project investigates how disruption of Spt6–Spn1 function influences:

- nucleosome positioning and occupancy
- nucleosome array regularity
- nucleosome repeat length (NRL)
- chromatin organization around transcription start sites (TSSs)
- chromatin organization around transcription end sites (TESs)
- RNA polymerase II behavior around gene ends
- transcriptional read-through and termination

The analyses combine **MNase-seq**, **NET-seq**, **RNA polymerase II profiling**, and **TSS-seq** data.


### `00_nucDetective`

Preprocessing and nucleosome analysis of the MNase-seq datasets using **[nucDetective](https://github.com/uschwartz/nucDetective)**.

The scripts generate sample sheets and run the `profiler` and `inspector` modules of nucDetective to obtain normalized nucleosome profiles, nucleosome calls, and nucleosome-regularity measurements.

### `01_Gene_Annotation`

Generation of the gene annotations used throughout the downstream analyses.

This includes:

- retrieval of the SGD annotation
- selection of verified protein-coding genes
- exclusion of blacklist regions and selected gene classes
- TSS- and TES-centered annotations
- identification of nucleosomes surrounding TSSs and TESs
- nucleosome-array regularity calculations
- gene classification according to neighboring-gene orientation
- generation of annotations for long genes

### `02_Fig1`

Analysis scripts used to generate Figure 1, including quantification and visualization of genomic feature occurrence around defined gene regions.

### `03_Suppl_Fig1`

Supplementary analyses of nucleosome organization, including:

- nucleosome repeat length (NRL)
- TSS-centered nucleosome profiles

### `04_Fig2`

Analysis of nucleosome organization around TSSs and TESs.

The analyses include:

- TES-centered nucleosome profiles
- TSS-centered nucleosome profiles
- stratification by gene orientation
- stratification by nucleosome-array regularity
- +1 nucleosome analysis
- TSS- and TES-associated nucleosome repeat length

### `05_Suppl_Fig2`

Analysis of the relationship between gene length and nucleosome organization.

### `06_Suppl_Fig3`

Additional nucleosome analyses using independent MNase-seq datasets, including TSS- and TES-centered profiles stratified by gene orientation and nucleosome-array regularity.

### `07_Fig3`

Analysis of transcription around transcription termination sites.

This includes:

- RNA polymerase II profiles around TESs
- association between RNA polymerase II occupancy and nucleosome regularity
- strand-specific NET-seq profiles
- transcription around the TES of long genes
- quantification of transcriptional stalling around gene ends

### `08_Suppl_Fig4`

Additional NET-seq and RNA polymerase II analyses, including:

- sense and antisense transcription around TESs
- RNA polymerase II profiles
- correlation of RNA polymerase II behavior with nucleosome regularity

### `09_Fig4`

TSS-seq and RNA polymerase II analyses around TSSs and TESs, including transcription directionality.

### `10_Suppl_Fig5`

Additional TSS-seq analyses of Spt6 mutant datasets around TSSs and TESs.


## Genome

The analyses use the *Saccharomyces cerevisiae* genome assembly **sacCer3**.

The SGD gene annotation can be downloaded using:

```bash
bash 01_Gene_Annotation/00_load_SGD_gene_annotation.sh
```


## Running the analyses

Clone the repository:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/uschwartz/SPN1_nucleosomes_termination.git
cd SPN1_nucleosomes_termination
```



## Data availability

The repository contains analysis code but does not contain the large sequencing datasets used in the study.

Public sequencing datasets used for the analyses should be obtained from their respective repositories. Dataset accession numbers and primary references should be taken from the associated manuscript.

## Citation

This repository accompanies the manuscript describing the effects of altered **Spt6–Spn1 function on nucleosome organization and transcription termination in budding yeast**.

Citation information will be added upon publication.

When referring specifically to the MNase-seq analysis workflow, please also cite the corresponding version of **nucDetective** used for the analysis.
